scope: TB-L7 GHG subsystem bank adoption only
existing_registry_note: ATB-SUB-002 remains an untouched TB01 adapter candidate. This fragment records narrower reusable GHG contracts and explicit unresolved gaps without converting GHG01 or runtime diagnostics into release authority.

entries.claim: The GHG subsystem has source-reachable CH4 and N2O process families with explicit qualified theory/source lineage boundaries, while exact revision-53 release specification, historical active behaviour and several release-specific equation details remain unresolved.
entries.failure_semantics: Any promotion of partial release-specific theory reconciliation or source reachability to complete revision-53 specification, historical behaviour or production readiness fails the contract.

entries.claim: TCD-037 accounting semantics distinguish CH4 layer/total formation and atmosphere emission, N2O nitrification/denitrification formation and atmosphere emission, with N2O reduction retained as a separate sink; parent TCD-037 is non-atomic and requires child-atom partitioning.
entries.failure_semantics: Conflating formation, emission or reduction ownership, or treating parent TCD-037 as a single atomic observer correction, fails the contract.

entries.claim: The closed GHG lower external advective air boundary requires Flair(Nl+1)=0 and compiler-dependent uninitialized first-use values are not model semantics.
entries.failure_semantics: Any dependence on stack/compiler initialization for the first lower-boundary read fails this contract, without implying production-patch admission.

entries.claim: Full-model C/N GHG conservation, explicit persistent task-state ownership, restart phase continuity and ponding layer-0 reconstruction remain incomplete or unresolved.
entries.failure_semantics: Fail closed: source-identified ownership and process reachability do not establish model-wide C/N closure or restart qualification.

entries.source_identity: ANIMO-GHG01 historical/reference boundary plus RUNTIMEQ03 evidence boundary
entries.claim: No supplied historical case reaches the GHG branch, the GHGMais compatibility descendant is diagnostic only, historical Intel behaviour is unknown, and no complete subsystem behavioural reference or release qualification exists.
entries.failure_semantics: Fail closed: diagnostic descendants or synthetic B1 evidence must not be promoted to historical B2, behavioural golden or release truth.
